text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's just not snapping into place... the pose for this special move!
I want it to look more martial artist-like, but...

text_block_list.name: Kung Fu Master
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's begin today's
kung fu calisthenics as well.
First, relax your shoulders~...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this might actually be useful...!
Maybe I'll go listen in for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~~!
May we ask you a few questions for an interview~?!

text_block_list.name: Kung Fu Master
text_block_list.text:
Now, once more!
Relax your arms, drop your elbows.
Drive straight through your opponent's centerline—

text_block_list.name: Kung Fu Master
text_block_list.text: Oho... You've got real talent! Well then, I suppose I could teach you an even deeper 'secret'—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the 'secret technique'!?
What is it, I wanna know! I really wanna know!
Please teach me...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki got so absorbed in researching special move poses
that she completely forgot all about training...
